description: Elections Commission - H. M. A. G. Herath of the Nikaweratiya Pradeshiya Sabha has Vacated Office of the member of Sri Lanka Podujana Peramuna
reasoning: This gazette notice declares that a member of the Nikaweratiya Pradeshiya Sabha has vacated their office due to ceasing membership in their political party. This is a notice under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance specifically dealing with the status of an elected member of a local government body, which falls under electoral processes and related matters.
